The winning line runs [pv:Rd5+ Kxf4 e3+ Kg4 Nf6+], with every Black reply met by forcing play that culminates in checkmate, and the evaluation stands at (#3 for White, Stockfish:16). This is the kind of forcing attack that leaves the defender no practical resources, and White went on to win the game.
